claim_text: Paragraph 8 of the Anwar Adow information recites Housing Stabilization Services program-wide payouts as more than $21 million (2021), $42 million (2022), $74 million (2023), $104 million (2024), and $61 million in the first six months of 2025, against a pre-launch DHS prediction of about $2.6 million annually. These are program_spend background figures in a charging document, not Anwar Adow’s alleged receipts and not proven fraud.

supporting_passages.quote: Before the Program’s inaugural year, DHS predicted the Program would cost about $2.6 million annually. That proved to be inaccurate. In 2021 alone, the Program paid out more than $21 million in claims. That figure ballooned in the following years: $42 million in 2022, $74 million in 2023, $104 million in 2024. In just the first six months of 2025, the Program paid out another $61 million.

editorial_notes: Do not sum these years into a headline HSS fraud total. Do not add them to Liberty Plus >$1.2M. ¶7 susceptibility language is not D/E evidence against a named official.
